notes: DISCOVERED during the scoos-2026-09-24 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-10), on the re-check that ledger's own 2026-09-01 row scheduled: that row recorded "no Board speech between 09-16 and month-end as of today, unusual for a post-decision fortnight; slots are added on short notice, so re-check each pulse." Nine days later the slot exists. THREE reasons it is worth a row rather than a mention. (1) It is the FIRST scheduled Board voice after the 2026-09-16 decision — the post-FOMC interpretation slot the corridor otherwise lacks — and it lands on triple-witching opex morning (opex-2026-09-18), alongside the BoJ decision and industrial production. (2) The format is a moderated "Chat", i.e. Q&A rather than prepared remarks alone, which the Waller precedent notes historically widens the range of what gets said; the announced topic constrains the prepared half only. (3) The announced topic is the SUPERVISORY leg of leverage — stress testing, bank capital — six days before scoos-2026-09-24 publishes the Fed's quarterly measurement of DEALER financing terms, and roughly thirty days fresher than it: the SCOOS response window closes ~2026-08-24 (see that ledger's Leg 6 / FT-45), so on the leverage conduit this speech is the LIVE read and SCOOS is the archival one. Impact MEDIUM rather than low on (1) and (2) — a post-decision Board voice in Q&A format is a rate-path risk irrespective of its billed subject — and NOT on (3), which is a reading interest for this book, not a price channel. symbols: [] and no house playbook attaches (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1 are symbol/earnings-keyed); the nine tracked names hold no bank or dealer exposure, so a supervisory-policy headline reaches them only through the rate path. Whoever researches this should re-derive both the tier and the symbols rather than inherit them, and should check whether the speech text or the Q&A touches non-bank financial intermediation and private-credit warehouse lending — the one line the June 2026 SCOOS flagged as deteriorating.
